answer: Before any man is given work, the master opens the book and checks the name against the mark. Brewer mash book with brewers attestation is the check that catches the copyist: eight-year book, 7,000 barrels brewed, malt accounts, quarterly audit. Claim a trade on a counterfeit lagoon and the claim is thrown out, the claimant pays the examination fee threefold and the terrace is struck from the roll, while the vault is recorded and produced whenever the claim is repeated.
